name: agentarmy-schema-migrator
description: Init-container function-tier image. Runs to completion before backend-core (or any other migration-consuming spoke) starts. Applies idempotent schema migrations against Postgres (DBOS system DB + app DB) via Alembic and ArcadeDB (graph schema) via REST DDL with idempotency guards. Pairs with ARC-ADR-023's 'init container' composition pattern and is owned by the schema-migration-engineer agent (per ARC-ADR-027).

shims.note: alembic drives Postgres (DBOS system DB + app DB); the apply_arcadedb.py runner POSTs versioned DDL files to ArcadeDB's REST /api/v1/command/{db} endpoint and records applied filenames in PG's arcadedb_migration_history table so reruns are no-ops. MODE=dryrun emits the plan without applying; MODE=rollback runs `alembic downgrade -1` (ArcadeDB DDL is forward-only).

baked.purpose: Alembic revision tree shared across spokes pointing at the same Postgres instance. Initial revision creates schema_version + arcadedb_migration_history (idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS).
Versioned ArcadeDB DDLs (CREATE TYPE, PROPERTY, INDEX...) with idempotency guards (IF NOT EXISTS where supported, runner-side already-exists error suppression otherwise).

Entrypoint: wait for PG (and ArcadeDB if ARCADEDB_URL set) → alembic upgrade head → apply pending ArcadeDB DDL files → exit 0. Bad MIGRATION_BAD_REV / connect timeout → nonzero so depends_on.condition: service_completed_successfully holds.
ArcadeDB DDL runner: skips already-applied files (tracked in PG), splits each file on `;\n`, POSTs each statement, treats well-known 'already exists' responses as idempotent success.
3-check doctor: applies migrations → applies again (no-op proof) → forces a bad revision (fail-fast proof). Spins up its own throwaway PG (+ optional ArcadeDB) so it's runnable cold.

doctor.description: First run creates schema_version (PG) + migration_marker (ArcadeDB); second run exits 0 with no alembic-version drift and no new arcadedb_migration_history rows; MIGRATION_BAD_REV=fakeXYZ makes the container exit nonzero so depends_on.condition: service_completed_successfully holds. Verified locally: 7/7 PASS (3 named checks, 7 sub-asserts across PG + ArcadeDB).

deploy.notes: Deployed as a Container Apps Job (run-to-completion) before the depending spoke. Locally composed via `depends_on.condition: service_completed_successfully` against the application-tier container.

contract.note: No external HTTP contract — this is an init container. The 'contract' is the migration-versioning convention (alembic linear history for Postgres; ArcadeDB DDL files tracked in PG's arcadedb_migration_history meta table).
